findings.issue: latestFlavorText's backwards scan is the single most regression-prone helper in the app and has no unit test
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests covering latest-English selection, whitespace collapsing (\n, \f), and the empty case

findings.issue: Pokémon→species mapping, dedupe by species id, dex-number sort and silent .catch(() => null) drop-outs are all untested; refactors can duplicate cards, link to variety names or shrink counts
findings.suggestion: Unit test with a mocked api() covering deoxys-normal→deoxys, alternate-form exclusion, ordering and fetch failure

findings.issue: Type/generation/search filtering and the pagination clamp+slice (NaN, negative, >totalPages) are untested arithmetic
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter+paginate step into a pure function and unit-test intersections, empty results, page clamping and per-page slicing

findings.issue: Client-side sort logic (missing-values-last in both directions, data-n numeric compare, aria-sort flip, Level-Up column offset) is the most fragile code in the app and untested
findings.suggestion: Add a small Playwright/browser test sorting Power and Level ascending/descending, including rows with missing values

findings.issue: acquire/release waiter handshake transiently over-admits (release decrements before the waiter increments), and rejected-promise cache eviction is untested; refactors can leak waiters or poison the cache
findings.suggestion: Unit test the pool with controlled promises (saturation, error propagation, re-fetch after failure)

findings.issue: Method-order comparator with sentinel substitution and the level-then-name default sort are subtle and unguarded
findings.suggestion: Unit test table ordering: level-up/machine/egg/tutor first, others alphabetical, level-up by level then name

findings.issue: The type filter's id<=10000 alternate-form rule and fallback-to-empty-on-error (catch → species=[]) are untested assumptions about API shape
findings.suggestion: Test with a fixture containing a >10000 id and an unknown type name

findings.issue: Default-variety and evolution-chain fetches have no catch, so a failure yields an unhandled 500 instead of a 404/error page; nothing distinguishes the two
findings.suggestion: Wrap in try/catch returning the not-found props, and add a route-level error-path test

findings.issue: URL-state contract (page reset on filter change, 250 ms debounce, param omission when empty) is untested; a refactor could break deep links like /?type=fire&generation=generation-i
findings.suggestion: Playwright test: type in search, verify URL and that page resets to 1

findings.issue: No test runner installed and no test script, so `npm test` inside app/ does nothing
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or playwright) as a devDependency and a `test` script covering the pure modules in src/lib/

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no runner, no script, no cases — and leans entirely on the acceptance suite it was handed. All of its genuinely risky logic (flavor-text selection, species mapping/dedup, filter+pagination arithmetic, client-side table sorting, the API cache/pool) is unguarded, so any refactor of the data layer will ship silently broken behaviour. Most of this is pure-module code that could be pinned down with an hour of vitest on src/lib/ plus two or three Playwright specs.
